Iris (CS): Heads-up — NewBridge Health (acct: NBH-21) dropped ~88% in generation + embed calls starting 2026-08-03. Renewal 2026-09-12. New Data Lead (Marta) started 7/30; procurement mentioned a short evaluation with SwitchboardAI. Need quick triage.
Noah (AM): Yikes. Can you paste the daily snapshot and any auth/billing flags? I'll loop in Marta and procurement.
Iris (CS): Quick usage snap:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(calls) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM api_usage
WHERE client_id='NBH-21' AND date >= '2026-07-20'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
-- 2026-08-02 calls=11,520 tokens=1.9M; 2026-08-03 calls=1,420 tokens=170k; 2026-08-04 calls=1,060 tokens=120k
```
Iris (CS): No 401s, but small retry bump and a handful of 403s from a service account on 8/03.
analytics-bot: Auto-detect — NBH-21 anomalies: calls -88%, 403 spike 0.1% -> 4.0% on 2026-08-03, avg latency stable.
billing-bot: Billing note — invoice INV-7821 disputed 2026-08-01; account active, payment pending.
Noah (AM): Probable vectors: procurement bench (SwitchboardAI), accidental key rotation, or they paused ingestion during eval. I'll ping Marta/mgmt.
Sam (Solutions): I'll grep logs for the 403s and map to key fingerprints/IP ranges. If they rotated keys, we should see a disable event. Posting a quick trace in a few mins.
Tasha (Onboarding): If they're re-evaluating, offer a short prompt parity + cost review session. I have Wed/Thu morning PT. Can prep a compact deck + checklist.
Iris (CS): Draft outreach for Noah to send — short and consultative:
"Hi Marta — noticed traffic dipped 8/3. If you're running a side-by-side with SwitchboardAI, we can run a 3-query perf + token-cost comparison on your real prompts and extend your trial 2 weeks so it's apples-to-apples. Also happy to validate key/SSO steps. No strings. — Iris"
Noah (AM): Sending now. @Tasha can you tentatively block Wed 9am PT?
Tasha (Onboarding): Blocked Wed 9am PT. Tentative invite ready.
Sam (Solutions): Initial log trace: 2026-08-03T14:07:12Z req id=qq key=fk_nbh_ingest resp=403 reason=key_disabled; subsequent retries show backoff. Looks like a service account was disabled ~14:06Z.
Iris (CS): That explains the 403s. Could be intentional during bench or accidental rotation. Either way, procurement + bench overlap is risky for renewal.
procurement-bot: Procurement note — SwitchboardAI trial requested 2026-08-02 by NBH procurement.
Noah (AM): Marta replied: they paused a couple of ingestion jobs while they validate SwitchboardAI results and noticed invoice formatting discrepancies. She asked if we can provide a token-cost table for three representative queries.
Sam (Solutions): If they share 3 prompts, I can run a quick harness (latency, token counts, per-query cost) and return results in ~24h. Recommend we include 95p latency and a sample cost projection at their current QPS.
Iris (CS): Plan: 1) Tasha runs a prompt parity session Wed 9am PT. 2) Sam runs bench after prompts arrive. 3) Offer 2-week trial extension + temporary bump in burst quota to re-run pipelines if they want. 4) Billing to follow up on INV-7821.
Tasha (Onboarding): I'll prep a 1-pager with tuning tips (batch sizes, KV cache for embeds, SDK backoff snippet) and include the SSO/checklist.
billing-bot: Created CS ticket CS-8340: "NewBridge usage drop — triage + billing follow-up". Renewal watch reminder scheduled for 2026-09-01.
Noah (AM): Owners: Noah (exec outreach), Iris (monitor/logs), Sam (bench), Tasha (enablement), Billing (INV-7821). I'll request prompts and push for bench before procurement finalizes.
Iris (CS): I'll keep watching logs for any resume or further drops and post updates here.
Sam (Solutions): Will stand by for prompts; can also run an isolated perf demo if they request an exec-level comparison.
Noah (AM): Thanks team. Goal: deliver bench + cost numbers within 48h of prompts so we can influence procurement decision. :hourglass:
